description: One Bid, one salt and one EIP-712 domain, with the hashes they must produce. TypeScript and Solidity both read this file and neither computes its own expected value. Regenerate it whenever a field name, a field type or the chain id changes; every hash below changes with them.
eip712Type: Bid(bytes32 auctionId,address supplier,string hotelId,string hotelName,uint8 stars,uint32 distanceMeters,uint256 price,bool refundable,bool breakfastIncluded,string roomType,uint8 numberOfRooms)

domain.name: Perdiem
domain.comment: verifyingContract is a placeholder SealedAuction address, not a deployment record.

bid.comment: Bid C of the demo table in docs/spec.md: the second cheapest bid, and the winner.
bid.priceComment: USDC minor units, as a decimal string: uint256 does not survive a JSON number.

expected.comment: bidHash is hashStruct: no salt, no domain. signingHash is keccak256(0x1901, domainSeparator, bidHash) and has no Solidity side, because nothing on chain verifies a bid signature. commitment is keccak256(abi.encode(bidHash, salt)), which the contract stores.
